answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 148335 Country: India Title: Please share your opinion about below names: Samara Anam and Hanana Iraj. Question: Please share your opinion about below names: Samara Anam and Hanana Iraj. Answer ID: 148335 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 499/445/SN=5/1438) Samara Anam and Hanana Iraj both are ambiguous names. No such words are available in the dictionary. Hence it is better to choose some other meaningful names. For girls: Juveriah, Maimunah, Safiyyah (name of the holy wives of the holy Prophet Muhammad - saws), Maria, Asma, Saleha, Shifa, Fatimah, Sadiah, Bushrah, Amatullah, Amatur Rahman etc are some good names. You may choose any of these names. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
